**Incremental review:** [Files changed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34805/files) against `main`.

## Review follow-up (2026-09-08)

Current head: `4ae62ebb29d2c6e610fae2e24d2dc345458da8cc`. The review fixes are in `b451dc83f1625ef3bd7d1bb9ae5ddf00161df97b`, followed by a formatting-only +3/-2 change matching main's Ruff context-manager layout. Both commits fast-forward the original `5afe107130fca73fea98c1a34a9119c9c23468f3` head.

- Check every actual consolidated layer buffer with `is_pinned()` before submitting to the coordinated producer. A requested pinning policy is no longer enough; pageable layers keep the existing copy path.
- Return before CUDA device resolution when the registry is empty or the input is a non-CUDA device.
- Add three real-hosting mixed-budget cases (none/one/all layers pinned; CUDA pinning and DMA are replaced only at the test boundary) and six no-CUDA guard cases.
- Preserve the opt-in defaults and PCIe/NUMA-specific scope.

Current-head local validation: **9 added tests passed**. The same nine tests against the unchanged prior implementation yielded **8 failed / 1 passed**. Full `test_prefetch_traffic.py` + `test_layerwise_offload.py`: **137 passed / 9 failed / 17 skipped**, versus **128 passed / 9 failed / 17 skipped** on the unchanged prior head. The same nine failure IDs and messages reproduce on both heads in this macOS CPU environment (three component-offload policy cases and six CPU-event API cases; only object addresses were normalized for comparison). The full suite is **not green**. The 17 skips require Linux `/proc`.

Environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.12.13, PyTorch 2.13.0, real checkout imports with `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE=cpu PYTHONPATH=python`. The original branch's applicable pre-commit hooks across changed PR files passed on `b451dc83`; upstream Lint then found one context-manager layout difference under main's newer Ruff rules. `4ae62ebb` applies exactly that +3/-2 formatting correction; the full two-file CPU suite was rerun with the same 137 passed / 9 baseline-matching failures / 17 skips. `git diff --check` passed. Current-head upstream Lint is tracked below. No new GPU/E2E/performance run was made for this head; the A100 results below are historical pre-review evidence, not revalidation of this update.

This review follow-up and local validation were AI-assisted.

## Motivation

Diffusion layerwise offload can enqueue a full layer's pinned-memory H2D copy while Ulysses `all_to_all_single` is using the same PCIe fabric. On PCIe-only multi-GPU systems, this overlap slows both the collective and the denoise step.

This PR adds an opt-in, communication-aware prefetch path that bounds H2D submission and creates a hard no-H2D window around standard NCCL Ulysses collectives.

## Modifications

- Add a rank-local prefetch traffic coordinator.
  - Prefetch producers reserve and publish bounded chunk completion events.
  - A collective closes admission and drains only the already admitted chunks.
  - The collective completion event is transferred back to the copy stream without a device-wide synchronization.
- Add a pure-DMA layerwise prefetch producer with configurable chunk size and in-flight depth.
- Guard standard and varlen NCCL Ulysses `all_to_all_single` calls.
- Keep the path disabled by default and fail closed unless CUDA, pinned host weights, contiguous consolidated buffers, and non-IPC Ulysses are in use.
- Document the opt-in environment variables and topology-specific tuning requirements.
- Add coordinator concurrency/error tests and layerwise lifecycle/configuration regression tests.

The defaults are:

```bash
SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_PREFETCH=0
SGLANG_DIT_PREFETCH_CHUNK_MIB=2
SGLANG_DIT_PREFETCH_INFLIGHT=2
```

## Accuracy Tests

Historical evidence from the pre-review PR; not rerun on the current head.

Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers, native SGLang backend, two A100 80GB PCIe GPUs, SP=2/Ulysses=2, 121 frames, two denoise steps, seed 42.

The ordinary layerwise-offload output and communication-aware output had the same MP4 SHA-256:

```text
93635bc24ffe3179c0a0c3ef9b0e60ac146e23526d7784674bf13da0e29504c2
```

Both backend fallback gates were empty.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Historical measurements from the pre-review PR; the current boundary fixes carry no new speedup claim.

Hardware: 2x NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe, PCIe Gen4 x16, GPU-to-GPU topology `NODE`, both GPUs on NUMA node 0, no NVLink.

Workload: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers, native SGLang backend, TP=1, SP=2, Ulysses=2, batch size 1, 121 frames, requested 1280x704, five denoise steps, seed 42, layerwise offload and pinned CPU memory enabled. Results are three interleaved process launches. Stable step time excludes step 0; `±` is the sample standard deviation across launches.

| Same-offload path | Stable denoise step | End-to-end |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary full-layer H2D | 3484.735 ± 8.272 ms | 32674.197 ± 64.989 ms |
| Communication-aware, 2 MiB, depth 2 | 3139.315 ± 13.796 ms | 30937.202 ± 53.756 ms |
| Change | **-9.912% (1.110x)** | **-5.316% (1.056x)** |

A single pristine-upstream sanity run measured 3479.378 ms stable step / 32631.169 ms end-to-end. The feature-disabled patched mean differed by +0.154% / +0.132%, within observed run-to-run variation. This is a default-path sanity check, not a statistically powered zero-overhead claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code according to the pre-commit configuration.
- [x] Add the 9 review-boundary regressions (passed; complete-suite limitations are reported above).
- [x] Update documentation.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

Current limitations: NVIDIA CUDA only; standard NCCL Ulysses only; CUDA-IPC A2A and stride-preserving host buffers are not supported by this path. Chunk size and depth must be calibrated on the target PCIe/NUMA topology.

+"""Rank-local coordination between bounded prefetch and collective traffic."""

+    synchronizes only the bounded set of admitted block events. This creates a

+        with self._condition:

+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import threading
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PrefetchTrafficCoordinator:
+    """Pause and drain bounded prefetch submissions around collectives.
+
+    Producers reserve a block before submitting it and publish a CUDA event
+    immediately after recording the copy. A collective closes admission and
+    synchronizes only the bounded set of admitted block events. This creates a
+    hard no-H2D boundary without a device-wide synchronization.
+    """

+        self._active_collectives = 0

+        self._latest_completion: tuple[int, torch.cuda.Event] | None = None
+        self._users = 0
+        self._next_block_token = 0
+        self._outstanding_blocks: dict[int, torch.cuda.Event | None] = {}
+
+    def register(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            self._users += 1
+
+    def unregister(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._users <= 0:
+                raise RuntimeError("prefetch coordinator unregister imbalance")
+            self._users -= 1

+    @property

+        with self._condition:

+        with self._condition:
+            self._active_collectives += 1
+            self._generation += 1
+            generation = self._generation
+            while any(event is None for event in self._outstanding_blocks.values()):
+                self._condition.wait()
+            outstanding = [
+                (token, event)
+                for token, event in self._outstanding_blocks.items()
+                if event is not None
+            ]
+
+        try:
+            for _, event in outstanding:
+                event.synchronize()
+        except BaseException:
+            with self._condition:
+                self._active_collectives -= 1
+                self._condition.notify_all()
+            raise
+
+        with self._condition:
+            for token, _ in outstanding:
+                self._outstanding_blocks.pop(token, None)
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+        return generation
+
+    def end_collective(self, generation: int, event: torch.cuda.Event) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._active_collectives <= 0:
+                raise RuntimeError("collective region imbalance")
+            if (
+                self._latest_completion is None
+                or generation > self._latest_completion[0]
+            ):
+                self._latest_completion = (generation, event)
+            self._active_collectives -= 1
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def abort_collective(self) -> None:
+        with self._condition:
+            if self._active_collectives <= 0:
+                raise RuntimeError("collective region imbalance")
+            self._active_collectives -= 1
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def before_submit_block(
+        self, copy_stream: torch.cuda.Stream, observed_generation: int
+    ) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """Wait for admission, transfer the comm dependency, and reserve a block."""
+        with self._condition:
+            while self._active_collectives:
+                self._condition.wait()
+            pending = self._latest_completion
+            if pending is not None and pending[0] > observed_generation:
+                generation, event = pending
+                copy_stream.wait_event(event)
+                observed_generation = generation
+            token = self._next_block_token
+            self._next_block_token += 1
+            self._outstanding_blocks[token] = None
+        return observed_generation, token
+
+    def publish_block(self, token: int, event: torch.cuda.Event) -> None:
+        """Publish the recorded completion event for a reserved block."""
+        with self._condition:
+            if token not in self._outstanding_blocks:
+                raise RuntimeError("unknown or retired prefetch block token")
+            if self._outstanding_blocks[token] is not None:
+                raise RuntimeError("prefetch block event published more than once")
+            self._outstanding_blocks[token] = event
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def retire_block(self, token: int) -> None:
+        """Forget a producer-retired block; idempotent with collective drain."""
+        with self._condition:
+            self._outstanding_blocks.pop(token, None)
+            self._condition.notify_all()
+
+    def cancel_block(self, token: int) -> None:
+        """Cancel a reservation whose CUDA work was never submitted."""
+        self.retire_block(token)
+
+
+_COORDINATORS: dict[int, PrefetchTrafficCoordinator] = {}
+_COORDINATORS_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+
+
+def _device_index(device: torch.device | int) -> int:
+    index = device if isinstance(device, int) else device.index
+    return torch.cuda.current_device() if index is None else index
+
+
+def get_prefetch_traffic_coordinator(
+    device: torch.device | int,
+) -> PrefetchTrafficCoordinator:
+    index = _device_index(device)
+    with _COORDINATORS_LOCK:
+        coordinator = _COORDINATORS.get(index)
+        if coordinator is None:
+            coordinator = PrefetchTrafficCoordinator()
+            _COORDINATORS[index] = coordinator
+        return coordinator
+
+
+def _get_active_prefetch_traffic_coordinator(
+    device: torch.device | int,
+) -> PrefetchTrafficCoordinator | None:
+    # Coordinators are installed during model initialization, before inference
+    # threads start. Avoid creating and locking a coordinator for the default,
+    # feature-disabled path that executes on every Ulysses collective.
+    if not _COORDINATORS or (
+        isinstance(device, torch.device) and device.type != "cuda"

+
+
+@contextmanager
+def collective_prefetch_guard(device: torch.device):
+    """Guard a synchronous current-stream collective when prefetch is active."""
+    coordinator = _get_active_prefetch_traffic_coordinator(device)
+    if coordinator is None or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+        yield
+        return
+
+    generation = coordinator.begin_collective()
+    try:
+        yield
+    except BaseException:
+        coordinator.abort_collective()
+        raise
+    else:
+        completion = torch.cuda.Event()
+        completion.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(device))
+        coordinator.end_collective(generation, completion)

+    synchronizes only the bounded set of admitted block events. This creates a
+    hard no-H2D boundary without a device-wide synchronization.

+        self._outstanding_blocks: dict[int, torch.cuda.Event | None] = {}

+        with self._condition:

+                self._outstanding_blocks.pop(token, None)
+            self._condition.notify_all()
